what_it_is.text: A deep cleaning removes plaque and tartar from below the gum line.

sentences.text: Common reasons for a deep cleaning include gum pockets and tartar below the gum line.
Your dental team can tell you why they suggested it for you.

what_happens.text: The area is usually numbed before the cleaning starts.

recovery.text: Many people have tender gums for a short while afterwards.

benefits.text: It can help the gums heal and fit more snugly around the teeth.

if_delayed.text: Gum problems can slowly get worse over time if they are not treated.

questions.text: How should I care for my gums afterwards?
